title: Resources
excerpt: Resources A resource is read only data — a file, a database row, a rendered report — that a connected client lists, reads, and attaches as context for the model. The client decides what to read: resources are application controlled, where tools are model controlled. Register a static resource registerResource takes a name, a fixed URI, metadata, and a read callback. resources/list now advertises config://app with that metadata, and resources/read on config://app runs the callback. ::: info Coming from v1? registerR...
